title: The effort is enough
coreMove: Place the standard inside the effort you control when outcomes refuse to reward you.
sourcePressure: Failure section: detaching worth from applause and returning it to disciplined effort. Supported by frozen TOC and book skeleton; no per-chapter source sidecar exists in the latest run.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Using effort as an excuse for weak standards rather than as the only honest score when results are unfair.
sourceAnchorNote: No named person, study, place, or artifact is available in the frozen source sidecar for this chapter; use fictional scenarios only and do not invent source anecdotes.
